openai.description: OpenAI GPT OCR via Responses API

gpt-6.1-sol.pricingNotes: Standard USD per million input/cached-input/output tokens: $2/$0.1/$10. Cache writes cost $2.5/M. Above 272,000 input tokens the entire request uses 2x input/cache and 1.5x output rates. Estimates use uncached Standard rates; cache writes, Batch/Flex discounts, Fast/Ultrafast tiers, regional uplifts, taxes and credits are excluded. Provider native reasoning default is medium. Page token shapes and latency are inherited from an earlier same-family model and are uncalibrated for this model.

limits.notes: Responses API text/image input, native JSON schema output; 1,050,000 context and 128,000 maximum output tokens. PDF inputs allow 50 MB per file and total request.
